title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
abstract: arXiv:2611.07909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. We present EDGAR (Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement), a conditional diffusion framework designed to enhance the quality of Gaussian avatars by correcting artifacts while preserving identity fidelity. To train EDGAR, we construct EDGAR-SET, a hybrid triplet dataset composed of real-captured and synthetic-rendered samples, which simulates realistic Gaussian avatar failure cases by pairing degraded renderings with ground-truth and reference images. translated_title: EDGAR：基于合成失败样本的高效扩散驱动高斯虚拟形象精修
translated_abstract: 高斯泼溅的最新进展已经实现了高效且照片级逼真的头部虚拟形象重建，然而基于单目视频或图像的方法仍受限于几何与纹理的欠约束问题，导致出现模糊、拉伸以及时间不稳定性等伪影。我们提出了EDGAR（Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement，高效扩散驱动高斯虚拟形象精修），这是一个条件扩散框架，旨在通过校正伪影来提升高斯虚拟形象的质量，同时保持身份一致性。为了训练EDGAR，我们构建了EDGAR-SET，一个由真实采集样本和合成渲染样本组成的混合三元组数据集，通过将降质渲染图像与真值图像和参考图像配对，模拟真实的高斯虚拟形象失败案例。EDGAR通过一个融合模块来精修降质帧，该模块将自监督Sapiens模型提取的身份特征注入到单步扩散骨干网络中，从而实现有效的……
tldr: 提出EDGAR条件扩散框架，利用真实与合成样本组成的混合三元组数据集来精修高斯虚拟形象的降质渲染，在保持身份一致性的同时有效校正模糊、拉伸等伪影。
en_tdlr: EDGAR is a conditional diffusion framework that refines degraded Gaussian avatar renderings using a hybrid real-synthetic triplet dataset (EDGAR-SET), correcting artifacts such as blurring and stretching while preserving identity fidelity.
